source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thanks for the feedback!
<http://Bayareasmashroom.com|Bayareasmashroom.com>
Is our site right now for our Bay Area locations which is San Francisco CA and Fairfield CA
WE USE WIX bookings
We are opening another location in Seattle WA so that one will be opened and Called Smash Room since our brand is Smash Room From now on . So we want to have our master site <http://SmashRoom.com|SmashRoom.com> to show our brand, locations, info all in one that can have sub links to our locations but also have all locations track their own bookings, revenue and sales all separately

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I want to build smash <http://room.com|room.com> from scratch but using the same template kind of thing. We are starting to franchise so we want to integrate new locations but they still have full control too.
This is one of our competitors and we really like the lay out. Simple , each location is listed and easy to navigate

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes and also if I want to make sure Seattle and Bay Area smash rooms things are separated that each location has their own payouts, calendar and revenue tracking

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes okay and would we actually be able to do it for $300 I’m short on my budget and I want to work with you

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Seattle will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Bay Area Smash Room.

Seattle needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SMASH ROOM brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Seattle should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Seattle Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

The page should be designed so that once Seattle opens, we only need to turn on booking and update photos without redesigning the page.

The Seattle page should become the template for future locations.

routing_warnings.description: This message concerns whether payouts are separate rather than operational data or access isolation.
The missing booking-software observation belongs to customer-facing booking functionality.
The account settings and subscriptions issue arises from the domain and site-profile assignment mismatch.
